4.2 Pharmacodynamics

Pharmacodynamics focuses on drug effects on the body.

Concepts: - Receptor binding - Agonists vs antagonists - Dose-response
relationships

Drug classes: - Antibiotics (beta-lactams, macrolides) -
Antihypertensives (ACE inhibitors, ARBs) - Analgesics (NSAIDs, opioids)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

metadata.document_summary: This report provides an in-depth analysis of pharmacodynamics and drug interactions, focusing on the effects of various drug classes. It is intended for medical professionals and researchers to enhance understanding of drug mechanisms.
